title: One-pot synthesis of fully biobased polyureas with excellent mechanical properties from epoxidized soybean oil
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,3019-3024
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00095E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lei Zhang, Donglin Tang
Ureido functions make soybean oil-based polymers tougher while maintaining the sustainability. Simply from urea, diamine and epoxidized soybean oil, urea functions were introduced in the backbone of polymers to achieve superior mechanical properties.
